reasons.peppm: PEPPM items: no price (behind the member login), a sample of each contract, many named only by a category or a part number
reasons.hgacbuy: HGACBuy items: no price (a discount with no list price to apply it to, or by quote)
reasons.no_price: Items with no price of any kind
reasons.burke_parts: Burke playground components the review did not code (by part-number family: everything but 550 to 599)
reasons.crash_parts: Items on New York's crash-mitigation award the review did not code
reasons.canon_extras: Canon licences, service plans and accessories the review did not code
reasons.rates: Rate lines, not products: hourly and monthly rates, fares, per-minute calls, rentals, fees and multi-year service prices
reasons.reviewed_parts: Parts and accessories, by the AI review: a component or an add-on of something else (a swing hanger, a copier finisher, a vehicle option)
reasons.reviewed_services: Rates and services, by the AI review: hourly and per-unit rates, installation, training, a study
reasons.not_a_package: Service lines that are not a fixed package, by the packaged-service review: time-based rates, goods mixed with labor, and one agency's own project line items
reasons.reviewed_doubtful: Products the AI review thought, without confidence, were a part, an accessory, a rate or a service (doubt keeps a product out; it never lets one in)
